title: 氧化溝污水處理
summary: 本課以環狀流場、污泥齡與氧需求的協調為主線，從入口負荷盤點、有效環槽容積、固體庫存與活性、食微比與負荷變動進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops coordinating loop flow, sludge age and oxygen demand through ten connected units, beginning with influent loading, effective loop volume, solids inventory and activity, food-to-microorganism ratio. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 入口負荷盤點：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Influent loading: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 入口負荷盤點 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Influent loading and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先分離水量尖峰與有機物尖峰，才能判定環槽需要調蓄還是反應容量。
steps.instructionEn: Separate hydraulic peaks from organic peaks before choosing equalization or reaction capacity.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Q=2000 m³/d；C=180 mg/L。模型 L=QC/1000，代入得到 360 kg/d。適用邊界：穩定流量與流量加權濃度；瞬時樣本不代表整日。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=2000 m³/d; C=180 mg/L. Model L=QC/1000 gives 360 kg/d. Applicability: Steady flow and flow-weighted concentration; a grab sample does not represent a day.
steps.failure: 單次低濃度樣本可能漏掉夜間排放。診斷與介入：先回查濃度基準與流量加權採樣，再重算負荷。
steps.failureEn: A low grab sample can miss nighttime discharge. Diagnostic response: First check the concentration basis and flow-weighted sampling, then recalculate loading.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「入口負荷盤點」的觀測點。比對累積流量計與流量比例混合樣本。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for influent loading. Compare the totalizing flowmeter with a flow-proportional composite sample. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只改變 C:180→210 mg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 360 變為 420 kg/d。用「入口負荷盤點」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。
knowledge.textEn: Change only C:180→210 mg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 360 to 420 kg/d. Explain the direction using influent loading, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「氧化溝污水處理」的「入口負荷盤點：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出污染或資源來源、處理單元、回收與排放的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「再生水品質交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配對採樣位置、濃度、流量、時間與品質旗標的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Influent loading: Mechanism and observation” in “Oxidation-ditch wastewater treatment”. Draw the source, treatment, recovery and discharge boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Water-reuse quality handover” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for paired sampling locations, concentrations, flows, times and quality flags, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.title: 有效環槽容積：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Effective loop volume: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 有效環槽容積 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Effective loop volume and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 環槽循環改善混合，但短流與沉積會縮小有效反應空間。
steps.instructionEn: Loop circulation promotes mixing, while short-circuiting and deposits reduce effective reaction volume.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：V=1500 m³；Q=3000 m³/d。模型 θ=24V/Q，代入得到 12 h。適用邊界：名義水力停留時間；不包含短流、死角及回流的停留時間分布。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: V=1500 m³; Q=3000 m³/d. Model θ=24V/Q gives 12 h. Applicability: Nominal hydraulic residence time; it does not resolve short-circuiting, dead zones or recirculation residence-time distributions.
steps.failure: 以土建總容積替代有效水體會高估時間。診斷與介入：用示蹤曲線及有效容積修正假設，先在模擬中比較分流方案。
steps.failureEn: Using gross civil volume overestimates residence. Diagnostic response: Revise assumptions using tracing/effective volume and compare flow-distribution options in simulation first.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「有效環槽容積」的觀測點。以槽有效容積與示蹤劑穿透曲線交叉檢查。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for effective loop volume. Cross-check effective volume with a tracer breakthrough curve. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.title: 有效環槽容積
knowledge.text: 環槽循環改善混合，但短流與沉積會縮小有效反應空間。
knowledge.textEn: Loop circulation promotes mixing, while short-circuiting and deposits reduce effective reaction volume.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只改變 Q:3000→3600 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 12 變為 10 h。用「有效環槽容積」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。
knowledge.textEn: Change only Q:3000→3600 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 12 to 10 h. Explain the direction using effective loop volume, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

quiz.question: 哪一項能解釋本單元的工程機制？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?
options: 看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
水在溝內循環一次即處理完成。
環槽循環改善混合，但短流與沉積會縮小有效反應空間。
optionsEn: An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
One circuit completes treatment.
Loop circulation promotes mixing, while short-circuiting and deposits reduce effective reaction volume.
quiz.explanation: 環槽循環改善混合，但短流與沉積會縮小有效反應空間。 在離線工作台先選取「有效環槽容積」的觀測點。以槽有效容積與示蹤劑穿透曲線交叉檢查。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
quiz.explanationEn: Loop circulation promotes mixing, while short-circuiting and deposits reduce effective reaction volume. In the offline workbench, select the observation point for effective loop volume. Cross-check effective volume with a tracer breakthrough curve. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 有效環槽容積：定量算例
steps.titleEn: Effective loop volume: Quantitative example
steps.objective: 重算 有效環槽容積 的教學算例，核對單位與適用條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Recalculate the teaching example for Effective loop volume and verify units and assumptions.
steps.instruction: 原創教學假設：V=1500 m³；Q=3000 m³/d。模型 θ=24V/Q，代入得到 12 h。適用邊界：名義水力停留時間；不包含短流、死角及回流的停留時間分布。
steps.instructionEn: Original teaching assumptions: V=1500 m³; Q=3000 m³/d. Model θ=24V/Q gives 12 h. Applicability: Nominal hydraulic residence time; it does not resolve short-circuiting, dead zones or recirculation residence-time distributions.

steps.failure: 以土建總容積替代有效水體會高估時間。診斷與介入：用示蹤曲線及有效容積修正假設，先在模擬中比較分流方案。
steps.failureEn: Using gross civil volume overestimates residence. Diagnostic response: Revise assumptions using tracing/effective volume and compare flow-distribution options in simulation first.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「有效環槽容積」的觀測點。以槽有效容積與示蹤劑穿透曲線交叉檢查。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for effective loop volume. Cross-check effective volume with a tracer breakthrough curve. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
